law.title: Required position and method of turning at intersections (3)
law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway, the approach for the left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof, and the turn must be made by turning from the right of the centerline where it enters the intersection as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway.

activation_conditions: the subject turns left from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway
residue: 'as close as practicable' is a judgement element bounding the lateral offset
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: approach position first, then the turn from right of the centreline, then arrival near the left curb
the whole manoeuvre is needed: approach, entry, exit
